title: Pholio Trust Registry call window
description: One recurring published open-call slot — "Thursdays 3–4 PM ET". Namespaced call_windows, not open_call: "open call" already means Pholio's own agency intake link. Only the talent-facing label says "open calls", because that is the industry term.

key.description: Stable natural key for this window. The sync derives the row's UUID from it, so re-running the release updates the same row instead of inserting a duplicate. Never recycle a key for a different window.

organizationId.description: Spec Registry organisation slug, when this agency is in the spec pack. Null is legitimate: a published open call is worth showing even for an agency Pholio has not researched a spec for, and displayName carries the row on its own.

agencyId.description: Live Pholio agencies.id, when the window belongs to one.

displayName.description: Always required — with both owner ids null this is the only thing naming the agency, and the Overview card renders it without a join either way.

startMinute.description: Minutes from local midnight in timezone. Null when the agency publishes the day but not the hour — a true and useful row, so it is representable rather than dropped.

timezone.description: IANA zone. Wall-clock minutes plus a zone, not a UTC instant: the fact is "Thursdays at 3pm their time", which does not move when daylight saving does.
